title: Reinstatement Timing Surcharge — Homesite Reservation
content:
The reinstatement timing surcharge on the fee for reinstating an expired Homesite Reservation hold is set by the calendar days from the date the hold expired, shown as the end date on the expired reservation, to today.

| Day the reinstatement is taken | Reinstatement timing surcharge |
|---|---|
| the third day or later after the hold expired | 50 percent |
| the second day after the hold expired | 25 percent |
| the first day after the hold expired, or any other day | nothing |

## Day count (hypothetical hold expired on 12 September)

| Reinstatement taken | Day after expiry | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| 13 September | first | nothing |
| 14 September | second | 25 percent |
| 15 September | third | 50 percent |
| 16 September | fourth | 50 percent |
